proposed_downscope_text: Phase 14.04 is explicitly downscoped from visible Codex chat/app/plugin UI proof to installed Codex skill adapter/core invocation proof. The accepted evidence proves the installed plugin skill can route a redacted request through the thin adapter into llm_mvp_core and produce redacted request/response/trace artifacts. It does not prove visible Codex chat/app UI submission, rendered response capture, or final Codex app/plugin readiness. Any final readiness claim must exclude visible Codex UI proof unless a sanctioned product hook is later added and exercised.
